scientific_integrity: Analytic all-integer proof with an independent-form full-matrix finite diagnostic, not an independently audited mathematical certificate. The oldest precisely dated consulted public source is Boyd (2007-05-15), with a later directly focused 2011 TU Chemnitz preprint.
scientific_limitations: Balanced double-star trees, unit sum of independently variable nonnegative edge conductances; bridge deletion requires permitting zero conductance. No claim for asymmetric double stars, other spectral objectives, or independent validation.
title: A sharp three-leaf bridge-deletion transition for Laplacian spectral-width design
